title: Default-off CPU-compatible CUDA Q8_0 arithmetic for MXFP4 x Q8_0

bottleneck_component.name: DeepSeek decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior

root_cause_evidence.classification: numerical/token-stability drift, not pre-fallback skip side effect

cpu_reference_semantics.main_loop: For two 32-value MXFP4/Q8_0 blocks at a time, CPU creates two 8-lane float vectors p_1/p_2, applies _mm256_fmadd_ps(scale, p, accum) into separate accum1/accum2, then computes hsum_float_8(accum1 + accum2).
cpu_reference_semantics.current_cuda_difference: Current CUDA sums one scalar accumulator in block order with sum += d * sumi, which changes FMA/rounding and horizontal-add order.

candidate.name: GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_CPU_COMPAT default-off kernel
implementation: Add a second CUDA kernel that mimics the AVX2 two-block, 8-lane accumulator structure.
Use fmaf(scale, lane_sum, acc_lane) for per-lane accumulation.
Use this kernel only for q80 probe/write/skip when the env gate is set.
candidate.expected_correctness_effect: Reduce or eliminate the ~1e-7 local drift that flips top1 at output-write max_calls=104.
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: No new model residency; temporary buffers unchanged.
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: Not evaluated in this correctness-only step.

correctness_gate.first_gate: Rebuild llama-results and run output-write max_calls=104 with GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_CPU_COMPAT=1.
correctness_gate.if_passes: Then test pre-fallback skip max_calls=104 with CPU_COMPAT=1 before any broader expansion.
correctness_gate.if_fails: Keep source default-off but mark this CPU-compatible attempt rejected or continue lower-level comparison; do not benchmark.

promotion_rule: This implementation cannot be promoted as SOTA by itself. New SOTA still requires strict cold France benchmark, 16GB page-cache accounting, TTFT gate, correctness, commit/push, and pushed-source reproduction.
